title: Pepi II
summary: King listed in CFAH-7B Table 16 (Egypt Dynasty 6).
description: Ruler of Egypt Dynasty 6. Person record added by the CFAH pass from the per-king rows of the OSF preprint CFAH-7B (Table 16, "Integrated Dates for Dynasty 6"); its dates are display only.
